exposure: Prophylactic occlusion balloons in both internal iliac arteries
cohort: 38 patients with placenta accreta spectrum disorders treated with cesarean hysterectomy
finding: In women undergoing cesarean hysterectomy for placenta accreta spectrum disorders, prophylactic internal iliac artery occlusion balloons were associated with significantly reduced blood loss, lower need for massive transfusions, and shorter operating times, without significant differences in morbidity.
gest_age: Median gestational age at delivery was between 36 and 37 weeks
